attempts.summary: Discovered node1's eth1, node2's enp8s0, and node3's enp8s0 form a flat shared L2 segment (confirmed via direct link-local ping node2<->node3, bypassing node1). Assigned static IPs (node1=192.168.50.1/24, node2=192.168.50.11/24, node3=192.168.50.12/24) — persistent via SONiC /etc/network/interfaces.d/eth1 on node1 and NetworkManager static profiles on node2/node3. Enforced port isolation with symmetric firewalld rich rules (drop by source IP) on node2 (blocks 192.168.50.12) and node3 (blocks 192.168.50.11), leaving node1 fully reachable from both. Verified baseline full-mesh connectivity before isolation, then verified node2<->node3 traffic blocked bidirectionally while both reach node1, both before and after a full reboot of every node (mandatory restart evidence protocol), confirming persistence of addressing and firewall rules across reboots.
